item.title: Broken pavement, 29th July
item.description:
Outside number 24 Tensing Road. Pavement has completely cracked and broken up to the point vegetation is now growing in it. Approx 3 metre long stretch of it. It’s broken up to the point that I’m constantly getting bits of broken pavement in my garden. The pavement is also very uneven due to the potholes making it a hazard for the numerous elderly people who live in the road.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 24, Tensing Road, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham

item.title: Dead adult deer on central reservation, 29th July
item.description:
An adult deer has been hit and is deceased on the central reservation of the A40. It does not obstruct traffic, though is on the Northern side of the barrier, accessible if travelling to Cheltenham from Gloucester. I first noticed it this morning around 7am, and it was still there around 3pm this afternoon.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): A40, Elmbridge, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: 50+ year old 40-50ft tall Silver Birch Tree has died., 29th July
item.description:
I reported this on 15th May 2026, report No. 9458186. The tree is now shedding it's branches, so far they have been smaller branches, however if it continues to deteriorate & some of the larger branches come down, it's most likely going to cause severe property & vehicle damage. It urgently needs attention.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2, Winton Close, Warden Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
